quarterly_data.signal: Eli Lilly's 10-Q: Q2 2026 consolidated revenue growth of 48% came from 60% volume growth, a 13% price decline and a 1% foreign-exchange benefit; outside the U.S. revenue rose 80% to $8,561 million on 113% volume growth and a 36% price decline. Mounjaro revenue was $4,791 million in the U.S. and $5,152 million outside the U.S. By region, Q2 revenue was $4,115 million in Europe, $941 million in China, $628 million in Japan and $2,877 million in the rest of the world. Six-month revenue was $42,773 million, up 51%.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 volume +60%, price -13%; outside U.S. $8,561 million (+80%; volume +113%, price -36%); Mounjaro U.S. $4,791 million, outside U.S. $5,152 million; Europe $4,115 million; China $941 million; Japan $628 million; 1H revenue $42,773 million (+51%)
